{{Quote|K-Kobal's World? How could '''you''' know about... about... Oh Lord. Those children, I killed them...|A stormtrooper recalls events on Kobal's World|<ref name="DLC">{{StoryCite|story=Dark Lord's Conscience|book=The Empire Strikes Back Monthly 155}}</ref>}}
'''Kobal's World''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Koradin sector/Legends|Koradin sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Kobal's World was the site of significant [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial atrocity on Kobal's World|atrocities]] during the era of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], including the slaughter of a number of [[Gender/Legends|women]] and [[Youngling/Legends|children]] by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]. One of those stormtroopers later [[Mission to Cheelit|accompanied]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] to [[Cheelit/Legends|Cheelit]], where the [[Guild of Vindicators]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Clat]] the Shamer used the memories to compel the [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] to commit [[Death/Legends|suicide]].<ref name="DLC" />
